sources.revision: Live issue pages/index inspected 2026-10-20; #1283 body retrieved through the GitHub API. Reports are open and refer to ACadSharp API/package/master versions as stated in their bodies; no peer code or artifact was run.
sources.observed: #1283 describes document-owned BlockRecord deep-copy recursion through nested Insert clones, quadratic construction, stack overflow, and self-insertion nontermination. #1281 reports recursive DXF reader advancement for repeated comments, XDATA app blocks, and WIPEOUT clip groups. #1282 reports one peer DWG writer narrowing an APPID EED length to signed 16-bit at 32,768 bytes. #1299 reports a downstream GDAL GeoJSON conversion failure for ACadSharp 3.8.0 DWG-to-DXF SPLINE output but does not provide structured spline arrays or an independently evaluated expected curve in the issue text.
sources.limits: These are issue reports for specific peer versions/APIs, not normative DWG/DXF limits or findings about libdxfrw. No attached customer drawing/archive was downloaded, and no ACadSharp/GDAL runtime was executed.

sources.project: Local implementation and generated owner tests
sources.revision: Shared working tree inspected 2026-10-20. No production or test source was changed in this research update.
sources.observed: DRW_Insert stores a block name/reference and DWG handles rather than an owning BlockRecord object graph. walkBlockRecordEntities uses the explicit R2004+ entMap traversal, while readDwgBlocks preflights ownership. testMixedMissingBlockOwnership currently generates an AC1027 three-entry owner list with the missing handle in the middle; it verifies lower-walker valid prefix/suffix delivery and strict outer quarantine of the malformed owner while a following valid block is processed. First-slot and final-slot missing cases are not directly asserted by this test.
sources.limits: A source/test coverage gap is not a confirmed runtime defect. No executable, CTest, full suite, fixture, or peer/native tool was run. The proposed extension stays inside the existing PAR-49 owner and uses generated in-memory frames.

implementationReadyDelta.change: Parameterize the missing AC1027 entMap entry across first, middle, and final positions using unique generated handles. For the low-level walker, verify resolvable children are visited in source order and the missing handle is diagnosed. For strict readBlocks(), require false/incomplete status, exact missing-handle plus BLOCK_RECORD diagnostic, no partial callbacks from the quarantined owner, and continued processing of the following valid owner.
